CONCERNING

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children.

The existence of Women and Child Victims of Violence have not yet received adequate Services and therefore minimum Services are required for victims of Violence. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to implement Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Child Victims of Violence particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

(2) 	Every person or Institution is prohibited from falsifying data/documents that result in the occurrence of Violence against Women and Children and/or the non-fulfillment of the rights of Children.
